name: Namespace

description_en: Developer infrastructure platform that accelerates software teams' build and test workflows, designed as the infrastructure layer for AI coding agents so developers and AI agents can build, test and run code faster

name: Instinct
description: 一个可以加入群聊的AI智能体，能够协助用户进行旅行规划、活动票务、梦幻联赛管理、拼车组织等任务。即使群组中的朋友没有注册Instinct账户，该AI智能体也能正常工作。最新融资后估值达到100亿美元。
description_en: An AI agent that can join group chats to assist with travel planning, event ticketing, fantasy league management, carpooling, and other collaborative tasks. The agent works even if group members haven't joined Instinct. Valued at $10 billion after its latest funding round.
why_matters: Instinct在群聊场景中实现了独特的隐私设计：个人智能体与群组智能体隔离，个人智能体在分享信息或执行操作前会征求用户许可，并且支持无账户用户参与群聊。这种架构在AI智能体的多用户协作和隐私保护方面提供了新的解决方案，区别于Meta AI等竞争对手。
why_matters_en: Instinct implements a unique privacy design in group chat scenarios: personal agents are siloed from group agents, personal agents ask permission before sharing information or taking actions, and it supports participation from users without accounts. This architecture provides a novel solution for multi-user collaboration and privacy protection in AI agents, differentiating it from competitors like Meta AI.
latest_news: 2026年10月5日，Instinct宣布推出群聊功能，率先向早期访问用户开放，并将很快扩展到所有用户。创始人Noah Shinn详细解释了该功能的隐私和安全机制。
latest_news_en: On October 5, 2026, Instinct announced the launch of group chat functionality, initially rolling out to early access users with plans to expand to all users soon. Founder Noah Shinn explained the privacy and security mechanisms in detail.
source_title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account

website_verification.title: Professional Dog Training & Behavior Therapy | Instinct Dog Behavior & Training Instinct Dog Behavior & Training

evidence.quote: Instinct, the AI agent now valued at $10 billion as of its latest funding round

Notably, the group chats with the AI agent will work even if a user's friends haven't joined Instinct, the company said. With the launch, Instinct moves ahead in its battle with top competitors in the space, like Meta's Muse. The latter doesn't yet offer the group chat functionality

name: Saia
description: 设计快速、低成本的AI推理芯片,直接在设备上运行推理,绕过传统内存,直接从闪存运行AI,相比Nvidia Jetson提供更高速度、8倍容量和4倍能效
description_en: Designs a fast, cost-efficient chip that runs AI inference directly on device by bypassing traditional memory and running AI directly from flash storage, claiming superior speeds, 8x capacity, and 4x better power efficiency versus Nvidia's Jetson
why_matters: 通过创新架构绕过昂贵且供应紧张的GPU内存,直接从闪存运行AI推理,解决了当前AI芯片的关键瓶颈;已与三星讨论内存集成,计划2027年开始测试芯片制造,2028年量产
why_matters_en: Bypasses expensive, power-hungry, and supply-constrained traditional memory used by Nvidia GPUs and Google TPUs by running AI directly from flash storage; already in discussions with Samsung for memory integration with plans to fabricate test chips in 2027 and mass production by 2028
latest_news: 入选PearX加速器,已与三星讨论内存集成,计划2027年开始芯片测试制造
latest_news_en: Selected for PearX accelerator, in discussions with Samsung regarding memory integration, plans to start fabricating test chips next year
source_title: 5 startups that caught VCs’ attention at the latest PearX demo day

evidence.quote: 20-year-old founder Ayaan Govil managed to convince Pear VC co-founder Mar Hershenson, a semiconductor engineer with a PhD in circuit design, to take a chance on his vision.

Saia claims to have designed a chip that bypasses traditional memory by running AI directly out of flash storage. The startup claims its chip delivers vastly superior speeds and eight times the capacity while using four times less power than Nvidia's Jetson
TechCrunch attended Pear's latest demo day, which took place in San Francisco last week, and then stuck around to ask some of the VCs about which companies stood out to them

name: Veros
description: AI原生信托和遗产规划平台,使用AI简化律师、财富管理人和信托管理人的工作,推荐结构并管理资产全生命周期,已管理2.5亿美元资产
description_en: AI native trust and estate planner that employs AI to simplify work normally done by attorneys, wealth managers, and trust administrators by recommending structures and managing assets over their lifetime, already managing $250 million in AUM
why_matters: 通过AI自动化简化了昂贵耗时的信托设置流程,已管理2.5亿美元资产并正在申请信托牌照以作为受监管的信托公司运营,展示了实际市场吸引力和业务成熟度
why_matters_en: Automates the expensive and time-consuming trust setup process with AI, already managing $250 million in AUM and in the process of securing a trust charter to operate as a regulated trust company, demonstrating real market traction and business maturity
latest_news: 已管理2.5亿美元资产,正在申请信托牌照以作为受监管的信托公司运营
latest_news_en: Already managing $250 million in AUM, in the process of securing a trust charter to operate as a regulated trust company
source_title: 5 startups that caught VCs’ attention at the latest PearX demo day

evidence.quote: Already managing $250 million in AUM, the startup is also in the process of securing a trust charter so it can operate as a regulated trust company itself.
Veros wants to simplify the work normally done by attorneys, wealth managers, and trust administrators by employing AI to recommend structures and manage assets over their lifetime.

name: Nous Research
description: 开发开源Hermes Agent的AI公司,推出面向企业的定制化AI代理服务,可处理多步骤工作流程并保持数据私密和安全
description_en: AI company developing the open source Hermes Agent, launching customized AI agents for businesses that can handle multi-step workflows while keeping data private and secure
why_matters: 开源Hermes Agent被克隆超过2400万次,驱动全球约2.5%的AI令牌使用量,2026年9月中旬年化收入约3600万美元,预计2026年底前突破1亿美元

latest_news: 2026年10月完成9000万美元B轮融资,估值15亿美元,由Robot Ventures领投,英伟达、Union Square Ventures等参与,总融资额达1.58亿美元,推出企业版Hermes
latest_news_en: Raised $90 million Series B at $1.5 billion valuation in October 2026 led by Robot Ventures with participation from Nvidia, Union Square Ventures and others, bringing total funding to $158 million, launched Hermes for Businesses
source_title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users

evidence.quote: has raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation
Nous was at roughly $36 million in annualized revenue by mid-September 2026 and expects to pass $100 million before the end of 2026

name: Autoheal
description: 帮助企业在软件工程工作流程中部署和持续改进AI代理的平台，专注于AI编码工具产生的运维工作负载管理
description_en: Platform that helps enterprises deploy and continuously improve AI agents across software engineering workflows, targeting operational workload created by AI coding tools
why_matters: 针对AI编码工具带来的新问题提供解决方案：虽然编码代理可以加速软件开发，但增加的代码也会产生更多漏洞、生产事件和监控工作负载，同时推高AI模型支出。Autoheal通过AI控制平面解决这一结构性痛点
why_matters_en: Addresses a structural problem created by AI coding tools: while coding agents accelerate development, the resulting code increase creates more vulnerabilities, production incidents, monitoring workloads, and drives up AI model spending. Autoheal solves this through an AI control plane
latest_news: 2026年9月完成790万美元种子轮融资，由Innovation Endeavors领投
latest_news_en: Raised $7.9 million seed round in September 2026 led by Innovation Endeavors
source_title: AI Startups Secure Major Funding: Highlights from September 2023, ETEntrepreneur

evidence.quote: AI startup Autoheal has raised $7.9 million in a seed round to build a platform that helps enterprises deploy and continuously improve AI agents across software engineering workflows. The round was led by Innovation Endeavors, with participation from Emergent Ventures, U&I Ventures, Darkmode Ventures, Batch Ventures and Param Hansa Values.

San Francisco-based Autoheal is targeting the operational workload created as companies increasingly use AI coding tools. While coding agents can accelerate software development, the resulting increase in code can also create more vulnerabilities, production incidents and monitoring workloads, while driving up spending on AI models.

name: Cori Clinical
description: 临床试验AI工作空间，整合组织历史试验知识与FDA、MHRA、EMA等监管机构外部情报，帮助临床团队将初步试验简报转化为完整协议、提交包和运营计划
description_en: AI workspace for clinical trials that integrates organizational knowledge from previous trials with external intelligence from trial registries and regulatory guidance (FDA, MHRA, EMA), helping clinical teams turn trial briefs into full protocols and operational plans
why_matters: 内部建模显示可将平均试验启动成本降低至少33%，AI审查器识别出82%可避免的协议错误；已与全球五大CRO中的两家合作，并支持鹿特丹Erasmus MC的神经外科和神经肿瘤学试验
why_matters_en: Internal modeling shows it can reduce average trial set-up costs by at least 33%; AI reviewer identified 82% of avoidable protocol errors; already working with two of the world's five largest CROs and supporting trials at Erasmus MC
latest_news: 2026年10月完成400万美元种子轮融资，由Breega领投，Enzo、Heartfelt、Together Ventures和Bynd参与；Emma Ogburn博士加入担任首席临床官
latest_news_en: Raised $4M seed funding in October 2026 led by Breega, with participation from Enzo, Heartfelt, Together Ventures and Bynd; Dr Emma Ogburn joined as Chief Clinical Officer
source_title: Cori Clinical secures $4M seed to improve clinical trial design and cut delays

evidence.quote: has raised $4 million in a seed funding round led by Breega, with participation from Enzo, Heartfelt, Together Ventures and Bynd
Dr Emma Ogburn as Chief Clinical Officer, bringing first-hand experience of addressing long clinical trial start-up timelines
Cori is already working with two of the world's five largest enterprise clinical research organisations (CROs)

name: Myca
description: 为农业企业提供AI代理协调现场团队运营的软件平台,将WhatsApp消息、电话和照片转化为结构化数据,并自动执行监督工作
description_en: AI agent software that coordinates agribusiness field teams, converting WhatsApp messages, calls and photos into structured data and automating supervisory follow-up work
why_matters: 针对全球南方国家农业企业的真实痛点,客户包括拜耳、Olam等大型企业,产品推出六个月即活跃于八个国家,在印度单个客户现场团队规模达5000人
why_matters_en: Addresses real pain points for Global South agribusinesses with customers including Bayer and Olam, active in 8 countries within 6 months of launch, managing field teams of up to 5,000 people per customer in India
latest_news: 2026年10月完成130万美元pre-seed轮融资,由Kriscore Capital和Eximius Ventures领投
latest_news_en: Raised $1.3 million pre-seed funding in October 2026, led by Kriscore Capital and Eximius Ventures
source_title: Myca raises $1.3m pre-seed to put AI agents in charge of agribusiness field operations - AgFunderNews

evidence.quote: Myca, best known for its AI agents that coordinate agribusiness field teams, has raised $1.3 million in pre-seed funding. Kriscore Capital led the round alongside Eximius Ventures, with participation from Indigram Labs Foundation and angel investors from the agriculture sector.
Founders Arnav Pandey, Tejas Dinkar and Seamus Tardif previously built an agritech company in Southeast Asia with more than $100 million in topline revenue, according to the company.

The product launched in April in India and Indonesia, and the company says it is now active in eight countries. Myca names Bayer, Olam Food Ingredients, ETG-Parrogate, BigHaat and Dayatani among its customers.

name: ChipMango

why_matters_en: As a US-Nigeria deeptech bridging semiconductors accessibility through cloud services, plans to establish European design hub in Malta and launch ecosystem/skills initiatives in Kigali, focusing on edge-AI and intelligent sensor IP development
latest_news: 2026年完成190万美元种子轮融资,由Atlantica Ventures领投,DFS Labs、Kaleo Ventures、Madica、Trilinear Technologies和Malta Ventures参投

evidence.quote: Funding: $1.9 million Seed
Founders: Ola Fadiran (CEO), Jovan Andjelich
Reached ~$200k ARR in 2025 at its Lagos design hub

name: Finches
description: 为农业采购开发AI预警系统,整合田间、采购和外部数据(气候、市场信息),为食品饮料、制药和化妆品行业提供供应链风险主动预警
description_en: AI early warning system for agricultural procurement that consolidates field, sourcing, and external data (climate, market information) to proactively warn food & beverage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics companies about supply chain risks
why_matters: 通过统一田间观测、供应商数据、天气模式、卫星图像等分散数据源,在作物歉收或质量问题威胁生产之前数月提供可操作预警,使采购团队能够提前安排备用供应商或调整生产
why_matters_en: Unifies scattered data sources including field observations, supplier profiles, weather patterns, and satellite imagery to provide actionable early warnings months before crop failures threaten production, enabling procurement teams to proactively secure alternative suppliers
latest_news: 2026年9月推出Finches Intelligence产品,早期客户包括一家领先的有机婴儿食品制造商和一家北美财富500强食品集团
latest_news_en: Launched Finches Intelligence in September 2026, with early customers including a leading organic baby food manufacturer and a North American Fortune 500 food conglomerate
source_title: Bavaria’s female-founded startup Finches raises €2 million to bring AI early warnings to agricultural procurement | EU-Startups

evidence.quote: Finches, a Bavaria-based startup developing AI for agricultural procurement, has raised €2 million in a pre-Seed funding round to accelerate product development and expand its sales operations. The round was led by High-Tech Gründerfonds (HTGF), with Vanagon Ventures joining as co-lead.
Founded in 2025 by Catharina van Delden (CEO) and Dr. Stefanie Glenn (CTO)

Finches consolidates field, sourcing, and external data (such as climate and market information) to proactively warn companies in the food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries about supply chain risks.

name: Mecka AI
description: 为物理AI构建数据和部署层的平台,通过身体传感器和iPhone收集第一人称视角的真实世界数据来训练人形机器人和其他类型的机器人
description_en: Platform building the data and deployment layer for physical AI by collecting real-world first-person perspective data from body sensors and iPhones to train humanoid and other robots
why_matters: 解决了机器人训练数据的关键瓶颈——不同于大语言模型所需的文本、图像和视频数据可以从互联网抓取,机器人所需的真实世界数据需要专门采集。该公司在六月就超过了1亿美元的年化收入,预计年底将达到3亿美元
why_matters_en: Addresses a critical bottleneck in robot training data—unlike text, images, and video for LLMs that can be scraped from the internet, robots require real-world data that must be specifically collected. The company surpassed $100M USD run-rate in June and expects to hit $300M by year-end
latest_news: 2026年10月宣布完成由红杉资本领投的6000万美元B轮融资,英伟达、微软、高通和三星参投,估值约5亿美元。此前在夏季刚完成3500万美元的A轮扩展融资
latest_news_en: Announced $60M USD Series B led by Sequoia Capital in October 2026, with participation from Nvidia, Microsoft, Qualcomm, and Samsung at ~$500M valuation, months after closing a $35M Series A extension
source_title: Mecka AI reveals $60-million USD Series B round backed by Sequoia, Nvidia

evidence.quote: Toronto- and New York City-based Mecka AI has raised a $60-million USD ($86-million CAD) Series B round led by Silicon Valley's Sequoia Capital.
The two-year-old startup also claimed it surpassed a $100-million USD run-rate in June and expects to hit $300 million by the end of this year.
DoorDash co-founder and CEO Tony Xu, ex-ServiceNow and Snowflake CEO Frank Slootman, and the former head of Tesla Optimus Milan Kovac also participated.

name: BioRender
description: 为科学研究人员提供AI驱动的生物图形制作平台,新推出的AI代理Leo能够像专业医学插画师一样指导用户规划、草绘和构建科学图像
description_en: AI-powered platform for scientists to create biological diagrams, with newly launched AI agent Leo that guides users through planning, sketching, and building scientific images like a trained medical illustrator
why_matters: 解决通用AI图像工具无法满足学术出版标准的问题,Leo使用经科学家审核的图标库和模板,帮助研究人员在几分钟而非几小时内生成准确、清晰且可编辑的科学图形,已服务超过400万科学家和全球前30大制药公司
why_matters_en: Addresses the failure of general-purpose AI image tools to meet academic publication standards; Leo uses scientist-vetted icons and templates to help researchers produce accurate, clear, and editable figures in minutes rather than hours, serving over 4 million scientists and all top 30 pharmaceutical firms
latest_news: 2026年10月7日发布AI代理Leo,2025年12月获得Dimension Capital投资,估值9亿美元,同年10月与Anthropic达成合作将图标库集成到Claude for Life Sciences模型
latest_news_en: Launched AI agent Leo on October 7, 2026; received secondary investment from Dimension Capital in December 2025 at $900M valuation; partnered with Anthropic in October 2025 to integrate library into Claude for Life Sciences
source_title: BioRender launches AI agent for building scientific research images

evidence.quote: BioRender parlayed that progress into a December 2025 secondary investment from biotech investor Dimension Capital that valued the startup at $900 million USD.

BioRender has built a so-called AI-powered 'Canva for Science' that helps more than four million scientists, thousands of research institutions, all of the world's top 30 pharmaceutical firms, and 15 Nobel Prize-winning labs

Leo uses the best available AI models for each step, while leveraging a library of scientist-vetted icons and templates. The company claims Leo can help clients produce accurate, clear, and editable figures with greater fidelity than general-purpose AI.

name: Kello

latest_news: 加入Peak XV的Surge 12批次,获得最高500万美元投资上限支持
latest_news_en: Joined Peak XV's Surge 12 cohort with up to $5 million investment ceiling

evidence.quote: The new batch, called Surge 12, is the first to operate under Peak XV's higher investment ceiling of up to $5 million per company, up from $3 million previously. The venture firm invested more than $50 million across the cohort
Gandhi says she was Airbnb's first female engineer, and she previously founded Upraised, while Jingade previously co-founded AmbitionBox
